deterministic.production_calibration: frozen active reference and E-matrix ROMs
deterministic.diagnostic_calibration: reuse per-grid recalibration evidence from source_blocker_run

coupling.shot_noise: pixelwise shared Poisson(min lambda over all settings) plus an independent Poisson(lambda_setting - min lambda) increment
coupling.read_noise: one shared Gaussian field per paired exposure
coupling.marginal_guarantee: sum of independent Poisson variables has the required setting-specific Poisson mean; shared Gaussian field has the required N(0,sigma^2) marginal
coupling.pairing_scope: all numerical settings within one amplitude/wavefront/flux/repeat cell

acceptance.equivalence_margin_nm: min(0.5, 0.05 * supported-reference mean residual in nm)
acceptance.independent_unit: wavefront mean over five nested noise exposures
acceptance.residual_rule: two-sided paired Student-t confidence interval for mean residual difference must lie wholly inside +/- equivalence_margin_nm
acceptance.prediction_rule: upper endpoint of the paired Student-t confidence interval for mean reconstructed-wavefront RMS difference must be <= equivalence_margin_nm
acceptance.cell_rule: both residual_rule and prediction_rule must pass
acceptance.comparison_rule: all four predeclared amplitude/flux cells must pass
